svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.19 ROOF SPACES
Clearances

g.text: SECTION THROUGH THE EAVE BETWEEN TRUSSES, MAGNIFIED
air space not less than 25 mm (1″),
with enough cross area for the
above the top of the insulation

svg.text: WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
Except as in Sentence (2), not less than 63 mm
(2½″) of space is provided between the top of
the insulation and the underside of the roof
sheathing
At the junction of sloped roofs and exterior
walls, where preformed baffles contain the
insulation, the baffles
(a) provide an unobstructed air space between the
insulation and the underside of the roof
sheathing that is (i) not less than 25 mm (1″) in
dimension, and (ii) of sufficient cross area to
meet the venting requirements of Article
9.19.1.2., and (b) extend vertically not less
than 50 mm (1 15/16″) above the top of the
insulation.
Ceiling insulation is installed so that it
does not restrict the free flow of air through
roof vents or through any portion of the attic
or roof space.
Drawn: cut between trusses, air space in light blue, the section magnified. Drawn spaces exceed the limits, sizes are illustration only.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.19.1.3. (page 9-137)
